validity.recommendation: Verify/relabel SegmentCost: GEM shows $255M but the only ref that names a Package-III pipeline EP cost ($118.53M, LAIC) and the Package-3 budget figure (>$372M, covering BOTH the 150 km SRG-3 and the 40 km SRG-2) bracket but do not match $255M. Source for $255M is unconfirmed.
validity.researcher_notes:
EXISTENCE: CONFIRMED real and physically built. P7714 = Aramco Master Gas System Expansion (MGS-2) Phase II, Package III 'Eastern Region Pipeline'. Independently described by DMS Projects (PRJ00021820) and METenders as 'construction of 150 kilometers of 56 inch pipeline on the Shedgum Riyadh Gas Pipeline 3 as well as 40 kilometers of 56 inch pipeline on the Shedgum Riyadh Gas 2.' LAIC/Lamar Industrial (contractor) page corroborates a ~150 km 56-inch line (EWPS #1 -> BGCS #3, designated SRG-3). MEED trade press confirms MGS-2 pipeline packages awarded to Arkad Engineering & Construction (~$1.3bn for the three main packages), EPC completed 2021. Not GEM-derived.
CLASSIFICATION: CORRECT. The Master Gas System is Aramco's dry/sales-gas transmission backbone (Yanbu<->Shedgum via Riyadh, 8.4 -> 12.5 bcf/d). PipelineType=transmission, Fuel=Gas both correct; no NGL/gathering misclassification.
DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate. The 150 km SRG-3 (P7714) and the 40 km SRG-2 (P7715) are explicitly two distinct pipelines within the same Package III per DMS/METenders/LAIC; the GEM split is correct, not a double-count. The MGS III cluster (P6717-P6737) is the separate Phase-3 (MGS-3, ~4153 km, construction since 2024) project, not this one.
ATTRIBUTION: Owner/operator Saudi Aramco (confirmed DMS, MEED). Contractor Arkad Engineering & Construction. Endpoints blank in GEM; sources give technical codes EWPS #1 -> BGCS #3, broadly the Shedgum->Riyadh corridor. Province blank (Eastern Province origin).
SPEC: Length 150 km and Diameter 56 in each confirmed by >=2 independent sources (DMS Projects + METenders + LAIC) -> high. Status=operating correct (MGS-2 EPC completed 2021). StartYear 2021 consistent with completion. The ONLY soft point is SegmentCost=$255,000,000: the existing metenders ref does NOT contain that figure (url_verifier could not find '255000000'); LAIC states the Package III EP scope at USD 118.53M, while DMS/MEED give the Package-3 budget at >$372M (which covers BOTH the 150 km and the 40 km lines together). $255M matches neither and its source is unverified -> flagged spec concern, do not silently pass.

summary: P7714 (Shedgum-Riyadh Gas Pipeline 3) confirmed real and correctly classified gas transmission line; 150 km/56in/operating corroborated by 2+ independent sources; lone caveat is an unverified $255M SegmentCost that matches neither the LAIC $118.53M nor the DMS/MEED >$372M Package-3 budget.
